jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 104 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core ed473c4b passed 31 container and 29 local HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown and video resume after restart. Official web completed the ordered three-track album through AAC HLS; official Qt 6 Desktop decoded both the guest artist solo and contributing FLAC tracks through EOF. Independent reads confirmed one added play per track and zero saved music resume. Both clients separate own albums from Appears On contributions. Isolated official Jellyfin 12.0.0 public observations support the saved music policy and artist-role/count matrix; 24 current-image selector reads and both artist count checks passed. Database checks cover roles, exclusions, paging, hidden credits, repeated plays, duplicate starts/stops, ownership, user edits and audiobook resume. Earlier client results retain their image-specific scope in acceptance.md. Explicit PlayCount writes, embedded tags, automatic artist creation, ambiguous names and credit-aware recommendations remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, longer converted audio, audible quality and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain unvalidated. Collections covers containing ancestors only; management and arbitrary membership remain incomplete. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained. Ended duplicate stops preserve later user edits, a qualified difference from the reference.
